BadGateway.description:
Bad Gateway - Error communicating with an upstream service.

**Action required:** Retry after a brief delay.

BadRequest.description:
Bad Request - The request was malformed or contains invalid parameters.

**Common causes:**
- Missing required fields
- Invalid field format (e.g., malformed email)
- Invalid JSON syntax
- Invalid parameter values

Conflict.description: Conflict - The request conflicts with the current state of the resource.

Forbidden.description:
Forbidden - You don't have permission to access this resource.

**Common causes:**
- API key doesn't have access to this endpoint
- Plan limitations

InternalServerError.description:
Internal Server Error - Something went wrong on our end.

**Action required:** Wait 30 seconds and retry. If the problem persists, contact support@leadmagic.io

NotFound.description:
Not Found - The requested resource could not be found.

**Common causes:**
- Profile doesn't exist or is not accessible
- Company not found in our database
- Invalid URL or identifier

PaymentRequired.description:
Payment Required - The request can't be paid for. Check `code`:
- `insufficient_credits`: add credits at https://app.leadmagic.io/settings/billing
- `credits_frozen`: credits are temporarily unavailable; contact support@leadmagic.io
- `org_closed`: the key is valid but the subscription has ended. Resubscribe at
  https://app.leadmagic.io/settings/billing, then retry with the same key. Retrying without
  resubscribing won't help, and repeated retries return `429` with `Retry-After`.

RateLimitExceeded.description:
Too Many Requests - Rate limit exceeded.

**Action required:** Check the `Retry-After` header for when to retry.

Also returned when the same rejected API key (`401 invalid_api_key` or `402 org_closed`)
is retried 10 or more times within 10 minutes. The key is paused for 15 minutes, then
1 hour, then 24 hours if retries continue. Fix the key or resubscribe instead of retrying.

**Headers returned:**
- `Retry-After`: Seconds until you can retry
- `RateLimit-Limit`: Your limit per minute
- `RateLimit-Remaining`: Remaining requests this minute
- `RateLimit-Reset`: Seconds until limit resets

ServiceUnavailable.description:
Service Unavailable - The service is temporarily unavailable.

**Action required:** Retry after a brief delay.

Unauthorized.description:
Unauthorized - Authentication failed.

**Common causes:**
- Missing X-API-Key header
- Invalid or expired API key
- Malformed API key

info.description:
# LeadMagic API Documentation

The LeadMagic API provides comprehensive B2B data enrichment services including email validation, email finding, profile search, company intelligence, and more.

## Quick Start

1. Get your API key from the [LeadMagic Dashboard](https://app.leadmagic.io)
2. Add the `X-API-Key` header to all requests
3. Start enriching your data!

## Base URL

All API requests should be made to: `https://api.leadmagic.io`

## Rate Limits

Email Finder and Email Validation have separate per-organization rolling 60-second RPM allowances: Basic/Essential 300, Growth 600, Professional 1000, Ultimate 1500. Keys and credit banks share each family allowance; queued bulk work counts per lookup. Other products have no commercial RPM cap; platform/provider and search RPS safeguards remain. A rejected 429 consumes no credits; honor Retry-After. Published limits may change unless an explicit written agreement fixes a rate.

## Fair Use

All API use is subject to LeadMagic [Fair Use](https://leadmagic.io/legal/terms#fair-use) and published plan limits. Low find rate alone is advisory and does not require an upgrade, suspend access, or change published outcome billing. Provider-health, security, and abuse safeguards still apply. Email Finder and Email Validation each use the published organization and product request allowance. Published limits may change unless an explicit written contract fixes the covered rate.

## Credits

API calls consume credits according to the endpoint's published billing outcomes. Finder charges for verified finds; Validation charges for conclusive results. A rate-rejected lookup consumes no credits. Existing credits retain their recorded terms. Check Billing and Credits history for recorded validity and /v1/credits for your balance.

## Support

Contact us at support@leadmagic.io for assistance.

post.description: Find local businesses for keyword × location combinations. Each unique combination is one search, charged 200 credits up front. US ZIP codes are resolved to their city before anything is charged. Set `dryRun` to preview the resolved grid and cost without charging.

cities.description: Locations to search (max 100): city names ("Austin", "Austin, TX", "Toronto") or US ZIP codes ("78704"). ZIPs resolve to their city; unrecognized ZIPs and non-US postal codes return 400. Outside the US, use the city name and set the country with countryCodes.

countryCodes.description: Two-letter country codes aligned by index with `cities`, or a single code applied to every city. Defaults to `US`.

dryRun.description: Return the resolved searches, `creditsRequired`, and remaining daily capacity without charging or queueing.

fileName.description: Label for the resulting job, shown in the dashboard.

keywords.description: Business types to search (max 25). Each keyword runs once per location; duplicates are charged once.

magicKey.description: Promotional key that waives credit charges when valid.

200.description: Dry-run preview (only when `dryRun` is true). Nothing is charged.

creditsCharged.description: Credits charged up front (totalSearches × 200, or 0 with a valid magic key).

locations.description: Each input location with the value that was searched.

position.description: Queue position when status is queued.

totalSearches.description: Unique keyword × location searches in the job.

202.description: Local-leads job accepted and credits charged.

402.description: Not enough credits for the search grid. Nothing was queued.

post.description:
Search 59 million local business listings by location, category, name or map radius.
Each lead is the full listing: address, coordinates, phones, emails, website and socials.

Pages hold **25 leads** and the size is fixed: `limit`, `offset` and `page` return 400.
Page with `next_cursor`. A search holds up to 1,000 leads for 30 minutes.

**Zero credits** on Professional (5 requests/second) and Ultimate (10 requests/second),
within the fair-use ceilings of 10 million records/month and 13,333 searches/day shared
across People, Company, Jobs and Local Leads Search. Other plans pay **1 credit per page**
at 5 requests/second. A page that is read again within 30 minutes is not charged again.

Every search needs a `country`, a point (`lat` and `lon`), a `website_domain`,
`email_domain` or `email`, or a `name` of five or more characters.

category_contains.description: Text contained in the category name. roof matches roofing.

category_group.description: Broader category group, such as food_and_drink.

country.description: Two-letter country code. Up to 5 per search.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page, sent with the same filters.

email.description: An exact email address on the listing.

email_domain.description: Domain of an email on the listing.

exclude_closed.description: True keeps open and unknown listings only.

has_business_email.description: An email on the business's own domain, not a free mailbox.

lat.description: Latitude of a point search. Send with lon. Results are nearest first.

lon.description: Longitude of a point search. Send with lat.

name.description: Text contained in the business name.

phone.description: A phone number in any format, 7 to 15 digits. Needs country.

postal_code.description: Postal code. A 5-digit US ZIP also matches ZIP+4 listings. Needs country.

radius_m.description: Radius of a point search, in metres.

region_code.description: State or region code, such as TX. Alias region. Needs country.

sort.description: Not allowed with a point search.

street.description: Text contained in the street address. Needs country.

website_domain.description: Website host. A bare host, a www. host or a URL. Alias domain.

credits_consumed.description: 0 on Professional and Ultimate, and 0 when the page was already paid for

credits_previously_consumed.description: Present when the page was first read by an earlier request

has_more.description: More pages remain in the stored result list

has_more_beyond_snapshot.description: The search matches more than the 1,000 leads it holds

interpreted_search.description: The filters as they were applied

category_inferred.description: True when the category was read from the business name.

distance_m.description: Metres from the point. Point searches only.

filled.description: Address fields filled in from neighbouring listings.

id.description: Stable listing id. Use it to remove duplicates.

next_cursor.description: Send back as cursor for the next page; null on the last page

snapshot_limit_reached.description: This is the last page of the 1,000 and more listings exist

total.description: Every listing the search matches; null when the count did not finish in time

200.description: One page of local leads (flat JSON body: not wrapped in data)

X-Credits-Consumed.description: Credits charged by this request (0 or 1)

X-Credits-Remaining.description: Wallet credits remaining after this request

X-LeadMagic-Search-Cache.description: cold for a new search, hit when the stored result list was reused

X-LeadMagic-Search-Tier.description: unmetered on Professional and Ultimate, metered on other plans

410.description: The cursor expired (restart_required) or the search is past its 1,000 leads (snapshot_limit_reached)

post.description: Find professional profiles by company, title, role, seniority, and recorded profile attributes. Choose a person before requesting Email Finder or Mobile Finder separately. Search does not expose contact values or availability indicators.

company_filters.description: Employer criteria supported by People Search: identity, industry, classification, headcount, revenue, founding year, headquarters, funding, and technology. tech_stack and each *_tech criterion accept at most 50 values and require every requested technology; more values match no records. This is a subset of standalone Company Search. Unsupported selected keys are listed in ignored_filters with warnings; accepted input does not guarantee application.

confirm_credit_charge.description: Accepted for backwards compatibility; not required and does not enable contact values in search.

cursor.description: Opaque signed next_cursor from the previous page. Send unchanged with the same filters, a limit no greater than 50, and offset 0.

limit.description: Offset requests allow up to 10000 rows; cursor-based pages are capped at 50.

linkedin_url.description: B2B company profile URL or slug.

offset.description: Legacy offset pagination; prefer cursor. Unstable ordering, uncached. Restart at offset 0 to obtain a cursor.

people_filters.description: Current professional-profile filters for name, title/function/level, persona, residence and job geography, profile identity, headline/about-me/description, recorded industry, language, seniority, job count, and connections. Residence, job location, and company headquarters are distinct filters and AND together. Freeform location/contact_location accepts at most five comma-separated terms; more terms match no records. This limit does not apply to explicit geography arrays. contact_job_function accepts short chips such as Sales or full standard department labels; contact_job_level selects exact levels. Role flags are stored title/function heuristics and can be incomplete or misclassified; they do not verify buying authority. Prefer contact_job_function and explicit titles for precise roles. min_seniority is an inclusive 0-5 role-rank floor (0 Other/unclassified, 1 Staff, 2 Manager, 3 Director, 4 VP, 5 C-Team), not buying-authority confidence. contact_persona matches literal label text ignoring case. Multiple values in the same supported text/enum array are OR'd; different filter keys are AND'd. Numeric bounds are inclusive. Prior-title history and follower counts are unavailable. Contact details are obtained through separate Email Finder or Mobile Finder requests. Selected criteria the current search cannot apply appear in top-level ignored_filters and warnings.

company.company_headline: The data provider other data providers use. Emails, mobiles, and company data that don't bounce.

people.contact_job_description: LeadMagic is the Best B2B Email & Mobile Finder

count.description: Number of people returned in this page, not total audience size.

credits_consumed.description: Finalized search credits; 1 per returned person on metered plans, or 0 for eligible included-plan searches. Separate enrichment requests are charged independently.

ignored_filters.description: Qualified keys of selected criteria that were not applied.

pagination.description: snapshot/cursor for cursor/first-page responses; offset for legacy offset responses.

next_cursor.description: Opaque signed token for the next page, or null on the last page. Send back as cursor with offset 0. Cursor pagination is stable and cached.

contact_job_function.description: Standard department label for the person's current role (e.g. Sales & Business Development). Filter requests may use short chips such as Sales; responses always return this standard label.

distinct_company_count.description: Legacy compatibility field; may be absent or null. Not a supported discovery filter.

followers.description: Legacy compatibility field; may be absent or null. Not a supported discovery filter.

job_observation_count.description: Legacy compatibility field; may be absent or null. Not a supported discovery filter.

seniority_score.description: Role rank: 0 Other/unclassified, 1 Staff, 2 Manager, 3 Director, 4 VP, 5 C-Team. Does not verify buying authority.

unlock.description: Compatibility metadata, if present. Does not enable contact values in search.

returned_count.description: Number of people returned in this page.

warnings.description: Explanations of unavailable or unapplied criteria.

post.description: Free helper endpoint that returns cached professional-profile and company counts, technology coverage, capabilities, and top dimensions for Jobs, Company, and People Search. Email and phone availability rollups are not exposed.

limit.description: Max top values per dimension. Defaults to 3.

products.description: Search products to include: jobs, company, and/or people stats.

sections.description: Stat sections to return: coverage counts, top dimensions, and/or filter capabilities.
